notes: Regular routing is the existing selected order basis. Precision routing is not assumed.

JLCPCB's 6.3 mm and larger holes are CNC routed; obtain CAM confirmation of the 6.4 mm H4/H6 locator-hole size and position limits. The 0.2 mm position bound is a conservative design allocation, not a quoted circular-routed-hole specification.
JLCPCB PCB capability limits do not define acrylic, CNC heatsink, FDM, keycap or component seating tolerances. Those entries are acceptance targets requiring supplier agreement or measurement.
The global rim, tightly spaced plate/heatsink interface, printed snap/thread fits and foam/preload still require tolerance review. This cap budget is not a tolerance release of the entire assembly.

Finished PCB thickness can be 1.44 to 1.76 mm. Front-datum heatsink dimensions do not automatically change by the full thickness tolerance; rear retainers, foam and case stack must be checked separately. Added-acrylic checks conservatively add 0.16 mm to nominal 0.25 mm Z travel.
